The '''Brak Sector Fleet''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]], assigned to the defense of [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It consisted of 2,400 [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including 30 [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and 1,600 other combat ships. The fleet was under the authority of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lesan Ramier]] who delegated naval command to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garrik Trier]].
